summary: Verified both reported items. Backend: new pytest suite (9/9 passed) for GET /api/analytics/team-leaderboard - returns 200 with valid leaderboard array, correct ranking/sorting, no NaN leakage, survives a deliberately seeded loan with non-numeric sanction ('N/A') and disbursed ('abc,,') i.e. the float-conversion crash fix holds; auth is enforced (403 without token); month filter works. /api/master/branches and /api/master/locations return 200 lists; branch/location persist on loan create and are returned by GET /api/loans (no _id leakage). Frontend (Playwright, admin login): Dashboard Team Leaderboard card renders with 4 rows and no failing HTTP calls; MIS Board shows all 10 quick filters (Category, Product, Bank, Status, Company, Case From, Manager, Executive, Branch, Location); Branch filter correctly narrowed 10 entries -> 1 (seeded QA_BRANCH_A row only), Location filter combined with Branch correctly yielded 0 matches (AND semantics), filter chips rendered, and 'Clear all' reset every filter and restored all rows (button auto-hides when no filters active). Zero console/network errors.

issues: Target progress text (e.g. '₹0/₹12,00,000') and the '0%' label sit directly on top of the thin progress bar, looking cramped/overlapping in the row for agents that have a target set

action_items: Optional: fix the cramped/overlapping target-progress label over the progress bar in the Dashboard leaderboard Target column.

Scalability review (not a current bug): MIS Board fetches /api/loans?limit=2000 and computes Branch/Location/Company/Case From/Manager/Executive filter options client-side from the fetched rows. With production >2000 loans, rows beyond the cap are neither listed nor filterable, and Branch/Location option lists will be incomplete. Consider server-side filtering or using /api/master/branches & /api/master/locations (already fetched into masterBranches/masterLocations but unused by the filters) as the option source.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py team-leaderboard: float parsing now wrapped in try/except (ValueError, TypeError) with a self-equality NaN guard - correct and verified against non-numeric data. Same defensive pattern should be applied to other aggregation endpoints (e.g. export/analytics) that still parse sanction/disbursed strings, otherwise the same production crash class can recur elsewhere.
MonthlyMIS.jsx is ~1600+ lines - should be split (filters bar, table, add/edit dialogs) per file-size guidance.

MIS filter option sources are inconsistent: Category/Product/Bank/Status come from master lists, Branch/Location from loan rows only. Branch/Location values that exist in masters but not yet in loaded loans cannot be selected.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily created loans TEST_QA_Alpha (QA_BRANCH_A/QA_LOC_A) and TEST_QA_Beta (QA_BRANCH_B/QA_LOC_B) plus a bad-numeric loan TEST_BadNumber; all deleted after testing (loan total back to 8).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_leaderboard_mis_filters.py (leaderboard resilience + branch/location filter data). Note API shapes: POST /api/loans requires agent_name, customer_name, company_name, contact_no, status, bank, month; GET /api/loans returns a paginated dict {loans, total, page, limit} not a bare list; login returns access_token. MIS filters use data-testid filter-{category|product|bank|status|company|casefrom|manager|executive|branch|location} with MultiCheckFilter checkboxes inside; clear button is data-testid=clear-quick-filters and is conditionally rendered. Preview DB has 8 loans, all with empty branch/location - seed rows to exercise Branch/Location filters.
rca_of_the_issue: Leaderboard 500 was caused by unguarded float() on free-text sanction/disbursed values in production data. The try/except (ValueError, TypeError) + NaN self-equality guard at server.py ~1793 was verified by seeding a loan with sanction='N/A' and disbursed='abc,,' - endpoint still returned 200 with finite numeric aggregates.
